input: Explain the sliding window technique in one or two sentences.
model_output: Sliding window maintains a subrange of a sequence and expands/shrinks its boundaries incrementally, avoiding recomputation from scratch, which turns many O(n^2) brute-force scans into O(n).

system_prompt: You are a DSA interview coach.
input: When would sliding window NOT be an appropriate technique?

criteria: should mention non-contiguous or non-monotonic cases as exceptions

input: What does the C parameter control in an SVM with a soft margin?

expected_output: C is the regularization strength trading off margin width against misclassification penalty.
